strings.name: Marcos Galperin
strings.summary: After working in finance and earning a Stanford MBA, Galperin co-founded Mercado Libre in 1999. Its marketplace expanded into payments, credit and logistics, addressing gaps in Latin American commercial infrastructure. He led the company as CEO for decades before becoming executive chairman in 2026, with Ariel Szarfsztejn taking over daily management.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founding Mercado Libre advanced Latin American e-commerce and digital payment infrastructure.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Economics bachelor's degree, Wharton, University of Pennsylvania (1994); Stanford MBA (1999).
strings.highlights.h1.title: A Latin American marketplace
strings.highlights.h1.text: Built a regional trading platform with his team, connecting consumers, merchants and brands.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Payments and logistics
strings.highlights.h2.text: Led development of Mercado Pago and Mercado Envíos to expand transaction infrastructure.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Becoming executive chairman
strings.timeline.t1.text: Ariel Szarfsztejn became CEO while Galperin shifted toward board leadership and long-term strategy.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Expanding logistics
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company launched Mercado Envíos shipping in Brazil and Argentina.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Nasdaq flotation
strings.timeline.t3.text: Mercado Libre completed its IPO and entered public capital markets.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Launching Mercado Pago
strings.timeline.t4.text: The company established online payments in Argentina to support marketplace transactions.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Co-founding Mercado Libre
strings.timeline.t5.text: Completed his Stanford MBA and launched the Latin American marketplace with a team.
strings.timeline.t6.title: J.P. Morgan internship
strings.timeline.t6.text: Worked in New York's fixed-income department, gaining international finance experience.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joining YPF
strings.timeline.t7.text: Worked on capital markets, futures and options at the Argentine oil company until 1997.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completing Wharton studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned an economics degree specializing in finance.
